title.en: An Act Naming the Longest Street in Barrio San Isidro, Municipality of San Francisco, Province of Cebu, the Quirino Maningo Road
title.orig: An Act Naming the Longest Street in Barrio San Isidro, Municipality of San Francisco, Province of Cebu, the Quirino Maningo Road

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1968/ra_5377_1968.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The longest street in Barrio San Isidro, Municipality of San Francisco, Province of Cebu, is hereby named Quirino Maningo Road.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1968.
